title: Natural unit and restriction squares for relative base change
statement: Let $X',X,S',S$ be schemes with a cartesian square $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to S'$, $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume $S,S'$ affine and $f$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the derived module categories of all schemes exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$, $K'\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'})$, and $\psi:Lg'^*K\to K'$. Let $U,V\subseteq X$ be quasi-compact opens covering $X$, with $U\cap V$ quasi-compact. Put $W'=g'^{-1}W$, $F=Lg^*Rf_*$ and $G=Rf'_*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Use the fixed open adjunctions, triangles $T(\delta),T'(\delta')$ and maps $a_0,a_2,a_{UV}$ of [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components]. For every such $K,K',\psi$, the first two squares commute: $F(T(0).\mathrm{mor}_1);a_2=a_0;G(T'(0).\mathrm{mor}_1)$ and $F(T(0).\mathrm{mor}_2);a_{UV}=a_2;G(T'(0).\mathrm{mor}_2)$. No connecting morphism is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0DJ9, induction step; naturality of the relative Mayer--Vietoris triangles from Cohomology, Lemma cohomology-lemma-unbounded-relative-mayer-vietoris

proof.text: Coefficient naturality of base change at each open unit, followed by mvOpenBaseChange_unit under Rf′_*, proves the full-f unit identity (private mvBaseChangeOpenMap_unit). Apply it to U and V. In private biprod_unit_square distribute composition over the diagonal sum, use lift_fst and lift_snd, insert these two unit identities, and reassemble the target lift using lift_eq and functor additivity.

Apply mvBaseChangeOpenMap_restriction to the two inclusions U∩V→U and U∩V→V. In private biprod_restriction_square, expand desc into its two projection summands, map the sum and the negative, insert both restriction identities, and cancel the biproduct inclusion/projection pairs. Reassemble the target difference map. The derived pullback is additive since it is a left adjoint; derived direct images are additive right derived functors. No boundary assertion or choice of connecting map is used.
